templates.title: Stremio Offline
templates.description: Unofficial self-hosted web client for Stremio addons, with catalogs, playback, downloads and a local library.
templates.note: Configure persistent data and download folders before deployment. The image and health check are ready to use; Intel QuickSync requires adding /dev/dri to the generated stack.

env.name: STREMIO_OFFLINE_PORT
env.label: Web UI port
env.description: Host port for the web interface.

env.name: DATA_PATH
env.label: Data folder
env.description: Host folder for accounts, addons, artwork and the application database.

env.name: DOWNLOAD_PATH
env.label: Download folder
env.description: Host folder for downloaded media and the default local library.

env.name: TZ
env.label: Timezone
env.description: IANA timezone used by the server.

env.name: PUID
env.label: User ID
env.description: UID that owns and writes the mounted folders.

env.name: PGID
env.label: Group ID
env.description: GID that owns and writes the mounted folders.

env.name: FIX_PERMISSIONS
env.label: Fix permissions
env.description: Set to 1 once when the data and download folders need to be chowned to PUID and PGID.

env.name: LIBRARY_ROOTS
env.label: Additional library roots
env.description: Comma-separated container paths for extra library folders. Leave empty to use only the download folder.

env.name: ALLOW_PRIVATE_ADDONS
env.label: Allow private-network addons
env.description: Only enable when every addon may reach the private network.

env.name: ALLOW_ADDON_HOSTS
env.label: Allowed private addon hosts
env.description: Comma-separated private hosts that addons may access. This is safer than ALLOW_PRIVATE_ADDONS.

env.name: IMAGE_CACHE_MB
env.label: Artwork cache limit (MB)
env.description: Maximum disk space used by the server-side artwork cache.

env.name: ARTWORK_CACHE_MB
env.label: Library thumbnail limit (MB)
env.description: Maximum disk space used by generated library thumbnails.
